cvc.name: CVC Corp Argentina
cvc.summary: As a Senior DevOps Engineer, I lead the design and evolution of scalable, high-availability Cloud architectures. I am responsible for defining automation standards using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), optimizing continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for multiple development teams, and improving observability strategies for the company's critical systems.
highlights: Technical leadership in Cloud infrastructure design
Advanced implementation of Infrastructure as Code
Evolution of SRE practices, observability, and DevOps culture

accusys.name: Accusys Technology
accusys.summary: As a Mid-level (SSR) DevOps Engineer, I managed Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery (CD) processes, optimizing infrastructure and automating deployments. Developed internal tools for artifact management using React and NodeJS. Key technologies: Jenkins, Ansible, SonarQube, React, NodeJS.
